# ex: implicit dereference cancels with inner address-of
ex {
	var t T
	t.Val() -> NewVal(&t)
}
-- x.go --
package p

type T struct{ v int }

func (t T) Val() int { return t.v }

func NewVal(t *T) int { return t.v }

func f() {
	p := &T{1}
	_ = p.Val()
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -8,5 +8,5 @@

 func f() {
 	p := &T{1}
-	_ = p.Val()
+	_ = NewVal(p)
 }
